title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E03 — Mistress
Richie struggles with his visions; Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border; the Fullers suffer an RV breakdown; Ranger Gonzalez seeks help from an expert.

title: The Condemned
description: A death-row inmate from a Central American jail is among the prisoners taken to a remote island for a to-the-death match broadcast live over the Internet.

title: The Condemned 2
description: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

title: Acts of Vengeance
description: A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Logan's War: Bound by Honor
description: A man (Chuck Norris) with the ability to foresee danger seeks vengeance on the mobsters who killed his family.

title: Safe
description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: Daybreakers
description: Faced with a critical blood shortage, a vampire hematologist joins forces with humans to perfect a cure for his problem.

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
description: As war looms in an idyllic kingdom, a man (Jason Statham) sets out to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claire Forlani) and avenge their murdered son.

title: In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds
description: A former special forces soldier is sent back to medieval times to fulfill a prophecy.

title: In the Name of the King 3: The Last Mission
description: Transported back to medieval times, a contract killer (Dominic Purcell) encounters a fierce army and a fire-breathing dragon.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E04 — Let's Get Ramblin'
Seth and Richie take the Fuller family hostage and attempt to leave the motel undetected, but Freddie -- led by the same force that has been guiding Richie -- arrives at their door, igniting a clash that nearly destroys them all.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E05 — Self-Contained
After a daring escape from the motel, Seth leads the Fullers' RV to the border crossing; an irrational fear takes hold of Richie; Jacob Fuller takes control of a volatile situation, determined to get his children safely across the border.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E05 — Filming Begins
The filmmakers meet with Robert to get advice pertaining to their upcoming shoots, which leads BK to question if she really needs the creative help she hired, or if her first movie making experience should be braved alone.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
description: A criminal organization kidnaps a young man with amnesia and turns him into a ruthless assassin.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Killing Them Softly
description: After a rival crook hires a pair of bumbling thieves (Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn) to rob their card game, mobsters hire a reluctant hit man (Brad Pitt) to settle the score.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: Bent
description: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

title: Guns Akimbo
description: Miles is a video game developer who inadvertently becomes the next participant in a real-life death match that streams online. While Miles soon excels at running away from everything, that won't help him outlast Nix, a killer at the top of her game.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

title: The Last Stand
description: A sheriff must take matters into his own hands when a notorious drug lord escapes from FBI custody and comes speeding toward a showdown in the lawman's quiet border town.

title: Lord of War
description: A relentless Interpol agent tracks an arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) trying to stay one step ahead of his business rivals.

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E06 — Place of Dead Roads
Gonzalez makes the crossing into Mexico, where he is captured by the cartel; at the bar, Seth is sure they have made a mistake, but Richie disagrees; Gonzalez escapes and makes it to the bar.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E06 — Filmmaking Isn't Easy
BK clashes with her director of photography as the two struggle to share a vision; Bola loses locations and her patience while trying to balance being on a reality show and being a director at the same time.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Runs Thick
The Gecko brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit; Richie's visions escalate; the Geckos nearly collide with the Fullers, a troubled family making its own desperate journey to Mexico.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E03 — Mistress
Richie struggles with his visions; Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border; the Fullers suffer an RV breakdown; Ranger Gonzalez seeks help from an expert.

title: Dredd
description: In a violent, futuristic metropolis, a law-enforcement officer (Karl Urban) and his rookie trainee (Olivia Thirlby) become caught up in a high-stakes conflict with a vicious prostitute-turned-drug lord (Lena Headey).

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

title: Python
description: Developed by the military, a massive snake escapes from its pen and stalks the residents of a small town.

title: Python 2
description: Genetically enhanced snakes go on a killing spree inside a Russian military base.

title: Acts of Vengeance
description: A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: The Forbidden Kingdom
description: A discovery made by a kung fu obsessed American teen sends him on an adventure to China, where he joins up with a band of martial arts warriors in order to free the imprisoned Monkey King.

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
description: While visiting an excavation site in Kenya, a former priest sees signs of demonic possession.

title: Future World
description: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. He soon finds himself in an epic battle against the Warlord and his henchmen to save the last remnants of humanity.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E06 — Luis Valdez
Luis Valdez discusses his journey from migrant farmworker to director; he also talks about the founding of Teatro Campesino, making "Zoot Suit" and "La Bamba."

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
Wrapping Up & Looking Back
Robert Rodriguez invites five amateur filmmakers to take on the same challenge he did 25 years ago with his first film -- to write, shoot and edit a brand-new feature length film with only $7,000.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E07 — Directors in Action
Bola's new attitude is tested as she encounters more filming hurtles; the cast gets surprise visits from Robert Rodriguez when he drops by their sets to see their work.
